priorityList: Apply Lethal and Non-Lethal poisons and enter Stealth before combat.
Use Deathmark if Garrote and Rupture are ticking and Kingsbane is ready.
Use Kingsbane if Garrote and Rupture are ticking and Deathmark is active or on a long cooldown.
Use Vanish to apply or refresh empowered Garrotes on multiple targets.
Use Thistle Tea if Energy is below 50% and the fight is nearly over.
Use offensive racial abilities and combat trinkets during Deathmark or Kingsbane windows.
Maintain Garrote on as many targets as possible, prioritizing empowered applications from Stealth or Vanish.
Maintain Rupture on your primary target; ensure it is ticking before consuming a Darkest Night proc.
Cast Crimson Tempest as a finisher in AoE if any targets are missing Garrote or Rupture.
Cast Envenom as your primary finisher at 5 or more Combo Points (or at maximum Combo Points if Darkest Night is active).
Use Shiv when Darkest Night is active and you are 1 Combo Point away from maximum to benefit from Toxic Stiletto.
Use Fan of Knives as your primary builder when 2 or more targets are present.
Use Ambush (on Blindside procs) or Mutilate as your builder against a single target.
Prioritize spending Combo Points on Envenom to build Implacable Tracker stacks.
Ensure Slice and Dice is active (refreshed automatically by Envenom via Cut to the Chase).
